[38;5;246m  ⎿  · Measured on Claude 2.1.318 and Codex 0.160.1: in both /model pickers, Enter SAVES the pick as your default for [39m

     [38;5;246mClaude's `/model <name>` with an argument also saves the default. What should choosing a model from the chat do? →
[39m     [38;5;246mSave as default[39m
     [38;5;246m· Claude's MCP prompts (e.g. /mcp__kicad__routing_strategy) are known only inside the running Claude process: no [39m
     [38;5;246mfile lists them, and the one listing API (a `claude -p` initialize sidecar) ran an UNTRUSTED repo's SessionStart [39m
     [38;5;246mhook in my test (ADR 0001). How should the chat's command list treat MCP prompts? → leave them out for now[39m

[38;5;231m⏺[39m You answered both questions:

  - [1m/model:[0m [1mSave as default[0m, which is not the recommended option. Picking a model from the chat will work like pressing
    Enter in the terminal: it becomes the default for new sessions and gets written to [38;5;153m~/.claude/settings.json[39m or
    [38;5;153m~/.codex/config.toml[39m. The chat's confirmation should say that it saves a default.
  - [1mMCP prompts:[0m [1mLeave them out for now.[0m The chat's command list will show built-ins, your own and project commands and
    skills, and plugin commands. MCP prompts stay terminal-only, and the proposal will record why: the only way to list
    them ran an untrusted repo's SessionStart hook (ADR 0001).
